Explanation:  
The question asks which Jason Statham movie released in 2010 could Dennis Hopper have lived to see the premiere of, given that Hopper died on May 29, 2010. The ground truth answer is "13." The predicted answer states that "13" (along with other Statham movies) premiered after Hopper’s death—specifically on September 13—and thus concludes that Hopper could not have lived to see the premiere of any of them. Since the predicted answer asserts that "13" premiered after Hopper's death (and he could not have seen it), while the ground truth says "13" is the correct answer (implying he could have seen it), the ground truth information is NOT present in the predicted answer.

Decision: FALSE
